title.zh: 将宿务省 Carcar 市镇的 Valladolid 国立中学附属校分离，改设为独立的 Roberto Sato 国立中学，并为此拨款
title.en: An Act Separating the Valladolid National High School Extension in the Municipality of Carcar, Province of Cebu from the Valladolid National High School and Converting it into an independent National High School to be known as the Roberto Sato National High School and appropriating funds therefor
title.orig: An Act Separating the Valladolid National High School Extension in the Municipality of Carcar, Province of Cebu from the Valladolid National High School and Converting it into an independent National High School to be known as the Roberto Sato National High School and appropriating funds therefor

completenessNote: 全文，共 5 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2000/ra_8789_2000.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The Valladolid National High School Extension in Barangay Calidngan, Municipality of Carcar, Province of Cebu, is hereby separated from the Valladolid National High School in the Municipality of Carcar and converted into an independent national high school to be known as the Roberto Sato National High School.
The Department of Education, Culture and Sports shall issue such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act.
All personnel, assets, liabilities and records of the Valladolid National High School Extension are hereby transferred to and absorbed by the Roberto Sato National High School.

The amount necessary for the implementation of this Act shall be charged against the current year's appropriations of the Roberto Sato National High School included under the Department of Education, Culture and Sports and thereafter in the annual General Appropriations Act.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
